nfl/los-angeles-chargers.h1: Chargers Rooting Guide, Week 11: Who To Root For This Week

status.line: The Chargers are 1-8, last in the AFC West and 14th in the AFC. Seven teams make the playoffs.
status.need: Realistically they have to win all eight games left to finish 9-8, and still need the teams below to lose. Here is what would help most.

own.label: First, The Chargers Have To Win
own.reason: Nothing else on this page matters if the Chargers lose. A ninth loss all but ends it.

sections.title: This Week
sections.sub: Sorted by how much each game helps the Chargers

games.reason: Pittsburgh holds a wild card spot right now. Every Steelers loss pulls that spot closer.
The Raiders are three wins ahead and already beat the Chargers. Denver is too far ahead to catch, so let them win.
Baltimore is one of the teams the Chargers have to pass. The Chargers beat them Monday, so they win a tie with the Ravens.
The Bengals, Steelers and Browns are all in one division. Only one can win it, and the other two are fighting for the same wild card spots.
When an AFC team plays an NFC team, root for the NFC team. An NFC win never hurts the Chargers.
Same rule: NFC team over AFC team. Kansas City is far ahead in the division.
Miami is tied with the Chargers at 1-8. Buffalo is out of reach, so a Bills win costs nothing.
Tennessee is also 1-8. Keep them from getting ahead.

done.reason: Houston moved to 4-6 and already beat the Chargers 44-22.

sections.footnote: No effect this week: Saints at Bears, Buccaneers at Lions and Vikings vs. 49ers are all NFC games. The Browns and Patriots are off.

sections.title: Next Week: Early Look
sections.sub: Week 12. This list updates Monday night once this week's games are final.

games.reason: A Chargers game that counts double. New England is the first team outside the playoff spots.

games.when: Friday, Nov. 27, 3:00 PM ET, Prime Video
games.reason: Both hold wild card spots. Pittsburgh has more losses, so it is the one to pull down.
Cleveland holds the last playoff spot. The Chargers still play the Raiders and can handle them in person.
One of them has to lose. The Chargers beat Baltimore and lost to Houston, so they want the Ravens to be the one ahead.
NFC team over AFC team.

college-football/usc-trojans.h1: USC Rooting Guide, Week 12: Who To Root For To Help USC Make The Playoff

status.line: USC is 7-3 and No. 18 in the College Football Playoff rankings. Twelve teams get in.
status.need: As the rankings stand today, the last open spot goes to No. 11. USC has to beat Maryland and No. 4 UCLA, then pass about seven teams. A committee picks the field, so these are our best reads, not math.

own.label: First, USC Has To Win
own.when: Saturday, 6:15 PM ET, Big Ten Network
own.reason: A fourth loss ends the playoff talk. Win, and next week at No. 4 UCLA becomes the biggest game of USC's season.

sections.title: This Week
sections.sub: Sorted by how much each game helps USC

games.reason: Ohio State has the same 7-3 record and sits four spots ahead, even though USC beat them 30-18. A fourth loss drops the Buckeyes behind USC.

games.when: Saturday, 2:30 PM ET, Big Ten Network
games.reason: Iowa is three spots ahead of USC. A third loss puts the Hawkeyes level with the Trojans.
Kentucky is 7-3 and two spots ahead. A fourth loss takes the Wildcats out of the way.
Yes, really. USC plays UCLA next week, and beating an unbeaten top-four team is worth far more than beating one that just lost.
BYU holds one of the last spots. A third loss opens it up.

games.matchup: No. 11 Wake Forest (9-1) at Georgia Tech (3-7)
games.reason: Wake Forest sits in the last spot today.
Texas Tech is the first team left out today and is in USC's way.
A third loss would pull Tennessee back toward USC's group.
Arizona is one spot behind USC with the same record. Keep them there.

done.reason: USC needed Michigan State. Oregon led 45-7 late in the fourth quarter. The Ducks are five spots ahead of USC and beat the Trojans in September.

sections.footnote: No. 17 Boise State is not on this list. One playoff spot is saved for the best conference champion outside the four biggest leagues, and Boise is chasing that one, not the open spots USC needs.

sections.title: Next Week: Early Look
sections.sub: Rivalry week. This list updates Tuesday night when the new playoff rankings come out.

games.reason: The whole season. A win here is the one result that can lift USC several spots at once.
Another chance for the Buckeyes to fall behind USC.
Oregon beat USC, so the Ducks stay ahead unless they lose again. USC also beat Washington, so a Huskies win makes that result look better.
Iowa is three spots ahead of USC.
Kentucky is ahead of USC. Louisville is behind.
